name: Sumai Realty
description: A trustworthy, data-first theme for estate agents and letting offices, drawn like an architect's sheet: cool paper white, slate and one brass line, Space Grotesk over IBM Plex Sans, square corners and floor-plan linework (dimension lines, plan frames with a door swing, rows that draw their walls on hover). The home page opens straight into a listings directory with Buy, Rent and New builds tabs and area and size filters (they work without JavaScript too); every listing has its own sheet with a spec table (price, m², rooms, floor, built, station walk) and a floor plan built from editable blocks. A two-tier header with an office strip, a blueprint map beside the address card in the footer, and about, journal, newsletter and contact pages. The office details and the directory are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, navigation, tabs, prices and every number in the listing rows and spec tables
